instructorNote: This is a clue inject. It shows that both "executives" were unauthenticated external guests joining from the same outside IP, and the organizer controls the only recording. Check that the CISO treats this as direct evidence of impersonation and orders preservation: the admin log export, the invitation, the participant list and any local copy of the recording, plus a request to the platform vendor to keep the organizer-held recording. Also check that the Treasury Manager puts WIRE-0914-004 on HOLD if it is not already held and tells the analyst not to delete anything.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: A monitor photographed at an angle, slight moiré and reflections. A laptop monitor photographed at a slight angle on a desk in a dim corporate security operations room, mid-morning. The screen shows a web admin console in a browser window: a meeting detail page with a participant table of three rows, two of them marked with small orange warning badges, and a compact recording panel with a cloud icon at the side. The interface is in muted corporate blue and grey, and its rows are too small and soft to read. Cool office light, a coffee mug and a notepad at the edge of the frame, an analyst's hand resting near the keyboard, shallow depth of field, quiet and tense mood.
